InstallExplanation: ExtGuide will keep the extension in a stable per-user folder. No administrator permission is required.
DestinationHint: The selected folder will contain an extension-specific child directory.
ChooseBaseFolder: Choose the base folder for the extension
Installing: Downloading, validating, and installing the extension...
FinishSubheading: ExtGuide prepared the folder. Chrome requires these final clicks from you.
Step1: 1   Turn on Developer mode in the upper-right corner.
Step3: 3   In the folder dialog, focus the location field (Ctrl+L).
Step4: 4   Paste the prepared path (Ctrl+V), then press Enter.
Step5: 5   Confirm the folder if Chrome asks.

VisualGuideCaption:

ChooseChromeHeading: Choose the Chrome installation to open
ValidatedChromeExplanation: Every listed application passed ExtGuide validation.
ManagedDeveloperTools: Your organization disables Chrome developer tools. Developer mode may also be restricted.
ManagedExtensions: Your organization blocks extension installation unless an administrator allows it.
